name: MindMarket
summary: A warm illustrated editorial system with cream-paper canvas, enormous Inter headlines, floating white pill navigation, 50px rounded cards and buttons, and flat paper-cut character art using green, blue, coral, and yellow accents.
coreMoves: Use Cream Paper as the page canvas.
Use Inter only, including giant 140-144px display headlines.
Use 50px radius for cards, buttons, and nav.
Reserve Pure White for elevated surfaces.
Use Fresh Grass as structural accent.
Use chromatic accents mainly inside illustration.
Use paper-cut character art directly on the canvas.
Avoid shadows, gradients, photography, and dense UI.
